description: Read your WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain, and workouts to understand daily readiness and historical trends.
example_prompts: Show my latest recovery and the sleep associated with it.
Compare my recovery and sleep over the last two weeks, noting missing or unscored days.
Show my workouts from the past week with strain and heart-rate zones.
Confirm which WHOOP account is connected and show my body measurements.
anything_else: Read-only official WHOOP v2 API. OAuth app activation is pending; personal data access requires WHOOP consent. No journal, private mobile APIs, or medical diagnosis.

authentication.credential: WHOOP browser authorization; MCP-issued bearer token managed by the client
authentication.configuration: Add the MCP URL in an OAuth-capable client and authorize your own WHOOP account in the browser. Do not paste credentials into prompts.
authentication.note: OAuth app activation is pending. Credentials are encrypted server-side for refresh; requested health records are sent to your MCP client but are not stored by this connector.

technical_specs.discovery: Standard MCP tools/list after OAuth; public documentation describes all tools.
